bagPolicy.summary: Only clear plastic or vinyl totes up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches or small nonclear clutches up to 6 × 9 inches may enter. Other bag types are prohibited and all bags are searched.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: General event parking requires a pass and costs $20 online in advance or $25 on the event day. Reserved, premier and tailgate options are offered separately.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The amphitheatre’s venue FAQ and arrival pages do not publish a designated rideshare pickup or drop-off point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and beverages are sold onsite with cashless payment. Each guest may bring one factory-sealed water bottle up to one liter or an empty plastic refillable bottle; outside food is permitted for dietary health needs in a clear one-gallon bag.
allowed: One sealed water bottle up to one liter

concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible parking is in Lots B and C near the gates. Both entrances are step free; call at least two weeks ahead for an assisted listening device or interpreter.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The amphitheatre does not allow guests to leave and re-enter during a show.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will call opens when doors open; bring photo ID. A meet-and-greet guest may also collect tickets at their assigned check-in time.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Concert parking lots generally open one to two hours before gates; gate times are posted close to each show. Enter at 2002 Lakewood Way SW and check the event-specific notice.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
